opus.problem: The birthday banquet and the girl's dance are not in Mark 6:23, which only has the oath of up to half the kingdom. These details come from Mark 6:21-22, so the reference should cover Mark 6:21-23.
The Pharisees' warning that this ruler wanted to kill Jesus is in Luke 13:31, not Luke 13:32, which only has Jesus' reply about 'that fox'. The reference should cover Luke 13:31-32.
